features.name: private_static_nested_classes
features.scope: Private nested ordinary and data classes with lexical source/compiled visibility, checked public exposure, JVM nesting and Kotlin metadata; fixed Java and cross-provider Kotlin consumers.
restrictions: Private inner, generic enclosing, open/abstract/sealed/value shapes and private enums remain bounded or unsupported.
Application source shapes motivate the feature; unchanged whole-file/app compilation and Android runtime are not claimed.
